newsitem.title: GERMANY: Credit Lyonnais ups Deutsche EPS forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais ups Deutsche EPS forecasts.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Securities said on Thursday it had raised its earnings per share forecasts for Deutsche Bank in 1997 and 1998 after the bank published stronger-than-expected profit growth for the first half of 1997.
Credit Lyonnais banking analyst Massimo Buonomo said in a statement he had raised his earnings per share forecast for 1997 to 4.77 marks, up from an earlier prediction of 4.38 marks.
He raised his 1998 forecast to 5.39 marks from 4.93.
Deutsche on Wednesday said its earnings per share in the first half of 1997 rose 26.1 percent to 2.90 marks from 2.30 marks.

Buonomo said commissions were expected to keep growing due to revenues from asset management but that trading profit growth was likely to slow down due to more uncertain market conditions in Bund trading.
Net profit growth is likely to slow down in 1998 because 1997 earnings were inflated by extraordinary profit, Buonomo said.
